damage.source: GOB 19 has a fixed type-5 target health effect of 8000 and a separate fixed caster IS restore of 50. Decoy1_Test requires the selected pet to belong to the caster.
damage.runtime: CoderPets reads both fixed effects from their GOB records. A surviving pet receives its new HP in the world view and pet window, while the owner receives the capped IS return.
damage.test: StarterDrainCodeDamageMode checks the full 8000 damage with Fortify active on a deliberately durable Proxy. The native run observed HP 9000 to 1000, IS 720 to 770, a surviving pet window and 58 s own reuse. PR680 and PR700 separately cover foreign, out-of-range and in-combat denial. The 60 s DecoyDuration and remaining complete behavior evidence stay open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/710#issuecomment-7071169854
